remarks: Welcome to River Terrace! Discover the perfect blend of space, comfort, and convenience in this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit. Ideally located near parks, tennis courts, golf courses, shops, and restaurants, this condo offers an open-concept living and dining area with sliding doors leading to a spacious deck overlooking the idyllic courtyard. Kitchen features granite countertops, perfect for any home chef. The primary bedroom boasts a walk in closet while the second bedroom is generously sized with a nearby full hall bath, making it ideal for guests. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, an intercom system, and ample storage options-with shared storage space in the basement. Enjoy the ease of 1 reserved carport parking along with 2nd parking in unassigned guest parking. Located just minutes from Stamford's vibrant downtown and offering quick access to Greenwich, this 1,325 sq. ft. second-floor unit provides an exceptional living experience.
